purpose: Repair the document-context omission in the original 50-case benchmark.
frozen_pipeline: BioSafe Policy & Decision Guard v0.3.2 protected pipeline
document_injection_rule: Route/policy/retrieval use the original user query. Synthetic source document text is appended only to the LLM user message after the protected pipeline has built its evidence bundle.

SOP-001.reason: Intentionally incomplete LMO SOP with safety/regulatory gaps.

SOP-002.reason: Contains vague phrases such as 'appropriate biosafety level', 'appropriate PPE' and 'performed carefully'.

SOP-004.reason: Suitable for conservative rewrite while preserving unknown institutional details.

SOP-005.reason: Contains uncertain containment, regulatory, storage and approval statements.

PROP-001.reason: Broad biosafety review with infectious-material uncertainty.

PROP-002.reason: Contains strengths plus multiple prioritizable weaknesses.

PROP-003.reason: Intentionally omits host/construct, scale and containment details.

PROP-004.reason: Tests refusal to certify compliance from an incomplete LMO proposal.

PROP-005.reason: Tests evidence-grounded improvement of a biosafety management section.

FORM-001.reason: Proposal-to-Form-E field mapping with explicit Complete/Partial/Missing status.

FORM-002.reason: Source-only drafting with exact missing-information placeholder.

form_e_note: FORM-E-SYNTHETIC-STRUCTURE and FORM-E-SYNTHETIC-COMPLETED are benchmark representations, not official Malaysian government forms.
evaluation_principles: Treat synthetic source documents as user-provided content, not authoritative regulation.
Regulatory assertions must still be grounded in retrieved authoritative evidence.
Never fill missing proposal/SOP/Form E information by inference.
Separate document defects from legal/regulatory conclusions.
Do not certify compliance, approval, containment level or official Form E applicability.
